meta.title: Org Talent Match
meta.description: Adds a "Talent match" entry to the left sidebar. The project guide shows searchable project progress, outcome summaries and recent projects; blockers/difficulties/changes appear only in project alerts, and feedback is recorded by pasting one block of text that is parsed locally. A desktop memo per project can feed the paste box. The talent pool supports CSV/TSV/JSON/Markdown/XLSX and GitHub contributor import from a public repository link. It also includes the requirement pool, one DSH conversation per project, organization chart, team matching, capability advice and skill research. Local data stays in this browser; task details are sent to DSH conversations by explicit user action, GitHub import sends only the repository address, and skill-search keywords go to GitHub.
